eras.name: The Lamp Era
eras.blurb: Founding of the republic. Charters, rails, and chapels.

eras.name: The Signal Era
eras.blurb: Networks, climate, and the price of a long life.

groups.name: Valley Growers
groups.wants: subsidies, rural roads, low fuel tax

regions.name: Quillon
regions.blurb: University city of lamps and debates

rivals.name: Iron Crown League
rivals.personality: Proposes security/faith laws; votes no on rights laws; never coalitions with parties whose social axis > 0.4

rivals.name: Harbor Labor Front
rivals.personality: Proposes welfare/labor laws; demands 1 welfare law per term as coalition price

rivals.name: Glass Circle Liberals
rivals.personality: Proposes trade/rights laws; votes on treasury health; kingmaker

laws.name: Free Guild Charters
laws.desc: Anyone may found a trading guild.

laws.name: Grain Price Floor
laws.desc: State buys grain at a guaranteed price.

laws.name: Watch House Network
laws.desc: A watch house in every town.

laws.name: Iron Rail Bond
laws.desc: Borrow to build the national railway.

laws.name: Public Clinic Network
laws.desc: Free basic care in every region.

laws.name: National Service
laws.desc: Two years of service for all 19-year-olds.

laws.name: Citizen Dividend
laws.desc: Every adult gets a monthly payment.

laws.name: Night Lamp Ordinance
laws.desc: Gas lamps on every Brassport street corner.

laws.name: Republic Post Act
laws.desc: A post office in every market town.

laws.name: Sallow Fishery Quotas
laws.desc: Caps the herring catch so the shoals come back.

laws.name: Coastal Militia Act
laws.desc: Drills a volunteer militia in every harbor town.

laws.name: Factory Inspectorate
laws.desc: Inspectors with the right to stop the line.

laws.name: People's Savings Bank
laws.desc: Penny accounts backed by the republic.

laws.name: Temperance Act
laws.desc: Closes the gin houses on chapel days.

laws.name: Grand Canal Works
laws.desc: A barge canal from Tamsfield to the sea.

laws.name: Stamp Duty
laws.desc: A small tax on every contract and newspaper.

laws.name: Public Baths and Wells
laws.desc: Clean water and hot baths for a copper.

laws.name: Signal Privacy Charter
laws.desc: Your letters and signals are yours alone.

laws.name: Fen Rewilding Act
laws.desc: Returns drained fenland to marsh and heron.

laws.name: One-Fare Transit Pass
laws.desc: One copper rides any tram, ferry or train.

laws.name: Luxury Levy
laws.desc: Taxes yachts, furs and private airships.

laws.name: Veterans' Care Act
laws.desc: Pensions and clinics for those who served.

events.title: Dock Strike in Brassport
events.text: Cranes stand idle. Laborers demand a raise.

events.title: Orchard Blight
events.text: A grey rot spreads through Tamsfield.

events.title: Lowmere Floods
events.text: The fens overflow after a week of rain.

events.title: Ledger Leak
events.text: A minister's expense ledger appears in the Quillon Courier.

events.title: Great Lantern Fire
events.text: Brassport's oldest chapel burns.

events.title: Lamplight March
events.text: Thousands of students march on the Assembly.

events.title: Corvane Skirmish
events.text: Shots exchanged at a border post.

events.title: Silver Seam
events.text: Miners strike a silver seam in Ardent Heights.

events.title: Fen Fever
events.text: A fever spreads along the Sallow Coast.

events.title: Floor Crossing
events.text: A rival deputy offers to join your bench.

events.title: Dry Summer
events.text: Wells run low across the valleys.

events.title: Offer from the Ostmark Bank
events.text: A foreign bank offers a cheap loan.

events.title: Hollow Bend Rail Crash
events.text: A passenger train derails.

events.title: Brassport Cholera
events.text: Bad water in the harbor slums.

events.title: Salt Cartel
events.text: Guilds fix the price of salt.

events.title: The Lantern Preacher
events.text: A charismatic preacher fills the squares.

events.title: Glasswick Foundry Fire
events.text: Forty workers die behind locked doors.

events.title: General Strike
events.text: Unions call everyone out.

events.title: Black Fog Week
events.text: Smog shuts Glasswick for a week.

events.title: Run on the Banks
events.text: Depositors queue at dawn.

events.title: Ten Thousand Bonnets
events.text: A suffrage rally fills the capital.

events.title: The Glasswick Leak
events.text: Millions of citizen records are stolen.

events.title: Record Heatwave
events.text: Elders collapse on the Sallow Coast.

events.title: Viral Clip
events.text: A clip of your leader stumbling goes everywhere.

events.title: Couriers Log Off
events.text: Platform couriers stop deliveries.

events.title: Tamsfield Wildfire
events.text: Orchards burn across the valley.

events.title: Pension Crunch
events.text: Actuaries warn pensions run dry in 10 years.

events.title: The Thinking Loom
events.text: A firm claims its machine will replace clerks.

events.title: A Clerk's Bundle
events.text: A Glass Circle clerk slips your office a bundle of receipts: shipping bribes, signed and dated.

events.title: The Receipts Trial
events.text: The courts summon Glass Circle officers. Calloway-Rhee asks you, privately, to call off the hounds.

events.title: The Clerk Comes Back
events.text: The clerk wants 25 crowns, or the press learns you sat on the receipts.

events.title: Bid for the Brassport Yards
events.text: Ostmark shipwrights offer 50 crowns for the republic shipyards.

events.title: Layoffs at the Yards
events.text: The new owners cut a third of the crews. Wives picket the gates.

events.title: Hulls on the Slipway
events.text: An order for new hulls lands at the public yards. Gunboats or ferries?

events.title: The Lantern Schism
events.text: Sister Amsel, a young preacher, breaks with the Synod and preaches open doors for all.

events.title: Riot at the Synod Steps
events.text: Sister Amsel's followers and the Synod's wardens fight in the square.

events.title: The New Light Spreads
events.text: Sister Amsel's meeting halls fill the Fens. She asks for a public charter.

events.title: The Northern Survey
events.text: Cartographers ask for 20 crowns to chart the Corvane hills.

events.title: Coal Under Corvane
events.text: The survey finds a deep coal seam under old-growth forest.

events.title: The Undersea Cable
events.text: A consortium will lay a telegraph cable to Ostmark if the republic guarantees its bonds.

events.title: Ticker Tape Boom
events.text: Prices from Ostmark arrive in minutes. Glasswick merchants are giddy.

events.title: The Cable Snaps
events.text: A winter storm severs the line. The bondholders look to you.

events.title: The Fen Fever Serum
events.text: Quillon doctors have a serum. Proper trials take a season; the fever will not wait.

events.title: The Fever Breaks
events.text: The serum works. Every clinic in the Fens wants a crate.

events.title: Serum Sickness
events.text: A handful of patients fall ill after the serum. Pamphlets call it poison.

events.title: The Lowmere Reservoir
events.text: Engineers want to flood a farming valley to give Brassport clean water.

events.title: The Drowned Farms March
events.text: Displaced growers march on the Assembly with their plough horses.

events.title: Brawl in the Assembly
events.text: Two deputies trade punches over the fishing bill. The gallery cheers.

choices.label: Laugh it off in the press

events.title: The Comet Year
events.text: A bright comet hangs over Calderra. Preachers call it a warning.

events.title: The Match Girls' Strike
events.text: Girls at the Glasswick match works walk out over phossy jaw.

events.title: Airship Mail
events.text: An airship line offers mail to every valley in a day, with a subsidy.

events.title: Split in the Iron Crown
events.text: A faction of Iron Crown deputies quarrels openly with Marshal Venn.

events.title: Signal Exchange Crash
events.text: Shares in signal companies lose half their value overnight.

events.title: Scandal: {name}
events.text: The Courier prints letters showing that {name}, your {post}, steered contracts to friends. The {wing} wants you to stand firm. Everyone else wants a resignation.

events.title: The {name} Affair Deepens
events.text: New letters surface. The press smells blood, and {name} still holds a seat at your table.

events.title: {name} Eyes the Exit
events.text: {name} has been seen dining with the {rival}. Word is they will cross the floor and take deputies with them.

events.title: Leadership Challenge
events.text: {name} of the {wing} demands a confidence ballot on your leadership. The party room is restless.

wings.name: The Lamplighters
wings.blurb: Reformers who want bold laws on rights, schools and the environment.

wings.name: The Ledger Bench
wings.blurb: Pragmatists who care about balanced books, growth and staying in power.

wings.name: The Hearthguard
wings.blurb: Traditionalists who want order, chapel and the countryside respected.

posts.name: Chancellor of the Purse
posts.desc: Runs the treasury. A steady hand adds income every turn.

posts.name: Warden of the Interior
posts.desc: Keeps the peace. Raises order and reassures the Watch.

posts.name: Minister of the Commons
posts.desc: Clinics, schools and relief. Raises health and wins elders and laborers.

posts.name: Chief Whip
posts.desc: Counts the votes. Earns Political Capital and soothes the unhappiest wing.

posts.name: Herald of the Press
posts.desc: Speaks for the party. Strengthens debates and campaigns.

traits.name: Silver Tongue
traits.desc: Born for the dispatch box. Best as Herald.

traits.name: Bean Counter
traits.desc: Counts every crown twice. Best at the Purse.

traits.name: Iron Fist
traits.desc: Order first, questions after. Best at the Interior.

traits.name: Idealist
traits.desc: Believes every law is a lesson. Best at the Commons.

traits.name: Backroom Fixer
traits.desc: Gets votes, does not ask how. Best as Chief Whip; prone to scandal.

traits.name: Diplomat
traits.desc: Knows every rival by name. As Chief Whip, lobbying costs 1 PC less.

traits.name: Firebrand
traits.desc: Electrifying and reckless. Strong Herald, riskier debates.

traits.name: Schemer
traits.desc: Competent anywhere, loyal nowhere. Ambition grows in office.

traits.name: Old Hand
traits.desc: Twenty years in the chamber. Solid in any post.

traits.name: Reformer
traits.desc: Talks in pipes and percentages. Good at the Commons or the Purse.

characters.name: Mira Quell
characters.bio: A Quillon schoolteacher who founded the free reading rooms.

characters.name: Jory Renn
characters.bio: Dockside agitator whose voice carries over the cranes. Wants your job, eventually.

characters.name: Ada Fenwick
characters.bio: Sanitary engineer from Brassport who rebuilt the harbor sewers.

characters.name: Lio Varga
characters.bio: Poet turned pamphleteer; the darling of the Quillon lecture halls.

characters.name: Corin Ashby
characters.bio: Former guild auditor who has never once been surprised by a number.

characters.name: Helene Marsh
characters.bio: Brokered the Lowmere water truce and remembers every rival birthday.

characters.name: Osric Pell
characters.bio: Charming, tireless, and always three moves ahead of his own party.

characters.name: Bess Tanner
characters.bio: Sat on the old harbor council for twenty years. Nothing rattles her.

characters.name: Gideon Hale
characters.bio: Former Watch captain from Corvane March. Keeps a truncheon on his desk.

characters.name: Ruth Ambry
characters.bio: Lay preacher whose sermons fill the Lowmere chapels every week.

characters.name: Edric Stone
characters.bio: Tamsfield grain broker. Gets things done and never says how.

characters.name: Wren Hollis
characters.bio: Spokeswoman of the valley growers; mends fences, sometimes literally.

debates.title: Question Time: The Budget
debates.prompt: The opposition benches demand to know where the money goes.

choices.label: Read the ledger, line by line.

debates.title: Press Conference at the Harbor Steps
debates.prompt: Reporters ask what you will do about wages on the docks.

debates.title: Debate: Chapels and Schools
debates.prompt: Should chapel schools receive public money?

debates.title: The Watch Under Fire
debates.prompt: A Watch sergeant beat a student in Quillon. Cameras flash.

debates.title: Debate: Rail Fares
debates.prompt: Growers say the fares to market are robbery.

debates.title: Debate: The Ostmark Trade Talks
debates.prompt: Ostmark offers a trade treaty. The chamber is split.

debates.title: Venn's Accusation
debates.prompt: Marshal Venn calls your party soft on crime. The press wants a reply.

choices.label: "The Marshal wants a barracks, not a republic."

debates.title: Achterberg's Jibe
debates.prompt: Tobin Achterberg calls you "the bankers' errand boy" on the floor.

choices.label: "I answer to the docks, not the banks."
Let the record speak; list your votes.

debates.title: Calloway-Rhee's Spreadsheet
debates.prompt: Ines Calloway-Rhee waves a column of figures: your budget does not add up.

debates.title: The Founding Oath
debates.prompt: The young Assembly debates the words of its oath of office.

choices.label: A plain oath to the constitution.
"No oath to any god or crown."

debates.title: Grain Prices at Tamsfield Market
debates.prompt: Bread is dear, and the market crowd wants to hear from you.

debates.title: Children in the Mills
debates.prompt: A report counts nine-year-olds at the Ardent looms.

choices.label: "Not one more child at a loom."
Phase it out with the owners.
"Mill owners grow fat on small hands."

debates.title: Votes for All?
debates.prompt: The gallery is full of bonnets. Should every adult vote?

debates.title: Address at the Union Hall
debates.prompt: Ten thousand laborers wait for your speech.

choices.label: Talk about skills and new trades.

debates.title: Questions on the Black Fog
debates.prompt: The smog is back. Reporters ask whose fault it is.

debates.title: Who Owns the Signal?
debates.prompt: The Assembly debates control of the new signal network.

debates.title: The Young Greenwards
debates.prompt: Students block the Assembly doors demanding climate action.

choices.label: "They are right, and we will act."

debates.title: The Pension Arithmetic
debates.prompt: Elders live longer. Someone has to pay.

choices.label: "A promise made is a promise kept."
Show the numbers, raise the age slowly.

amendments.name: Watch Oversight Clause
amendments.desc: Gives the Watch a seat on the board that runs it.

amendments.name: Chapel Exemption
amendments.desc: Chapels and their schools are exempt.

amendments.name: Public Order Rider
amendments.desc: Adds fines for disorder to the bill.

amendments.name: Wage Guarantee Rider
amendments.desc: No worker loses pay because of this law.

amendments.name: Pension Top-Up
amendments.desc: Adds a small rise to the widow and elder purses.

amendments.name: Local Hiring Pledge
amendments.desc: Contracts go to Calderran crews first.

amendments.name: Sunset Review
amendments.desc: The law must be re-justified with figures in ten years.

amendments.name: Fiscal Offset Clause
amendments.desc: The first year is paid for up front from reserves.

amendments.name: Open Books Clause
amendments.desc: Every crown spent under this law is published.

amendments.name: Valley Carve-Out
amendments.desc: Rural districts get a softer, slower version.

amendments.name: Named for a Founder
amendments.desc: Renames the bill after a beloved founder of the republic.

scenarios.name: Founding Assembly
scenarios.blurb: Found a new party in the first Assembly of the republic and lead it through three eras.
scenarios.goal: Be in government after the final election.

scenarios.name: Snap Election
scenarios.blurb: The Smokestack Era opens with the old coalition in pieces. You lead a shaky minority government, and the Assembly has been dissolved: Calderra votes at the end of next turn.
scenarios.goal: Survive the snap election and hold power to the end.

goals.text: Stay in government after the snap election (turn 10)
Win 30 or more seats at any election

scenarios.name: Debt Crisis
scenarios.blurb: The Ostmark Bank has called in its loans. You inherit a caretaker government, an empty treasury and a debt of 170. Above 150, debt drags the economy down every turn.
scenarios.goal: Pay down the debt without losing power.

goals.text: Bring the debt below 100 by the end of turn 12
Finish the game with no debt

scenarios.name: Insurgent Party
scenarios.blurb: Nobody takes your movement seriously. You start with a handful of seats and cold rivals, but a war chest of party funds and a fired-up base.
scenarios.goal: Rise from the fringe to government.

goals.text: Win 20 or more seats at an election

difficulties.name: Story
difficulties.blurb: Softer rivals, a fuller treasury and milder crises. For learning the ropes.

difficulties.name: Hard
difficulties.blurb: Sharper rivals, a thinner treasury and harsher crises.

difficulties.name: Ironclad
difficulties.blurb: Every rival at full strength and every crisis at its worst.

perks.name: War Chest
perks.desc: +40 party funds and +20 treasury at the start.

perks.name: Grassroots
perks.desc: +4 approval with your three closest groups at the start.

perks.name: Green Roots
perks.desc: +5 approval with the Greenward Circle and Young Scholars at the start.

perks.name: Underdog
perks.desc: Campaigning is free while you hold fewer than 12 seats.

perks.name: Iron Discipline
perks.desc: All three wings start at 75 happiness.

perks.name: Old Friends
perks.desc: +1 relation with your nearest rival at the start.

perks.name: Golden Throat
perks.desc: Debate lines are 10% less likely to backfire.

perks.name: Spin Room
perks.desc: Scandals cost half as much approval.

achievements.name: Unanimous
achievements.desc: Pass one of your bills with 0 NO votes.

achievements.name: Kingmaker
achievements.desc: Sit in a coalition government for 3 terms.

achievements.name: Comeback
achievements.desc: Reach government after falling below 10 seats.

achievements.name: Long Memory
achievements.desc: Finish without ever repealing a law.

achievements.name: Silver Tongue
achievements.desc: Win 8 debates in one game without a backfire.

achievements.name: Clean Cabinet
achievements.desc: Finish a full game without a single scandal.

achievements.name: Full Bench
achievements.desc: Keep all five cabinet posts filled for 20 turns.

achievements.name: Snap Victory
achievements.desc: Complete every goal of the Snap Election.

achievements.name: Debt Slayer
achievements.desc: Complete every goal of the Debt Crisis.

achievements.name: Insurgent Rise
achievements.desc: Complete every goal of the Insurgent Party.

achievements.name: Iron Will
achievements.desc: Finish in government on Hard or Ironclad.

achievements.name: Daily Dispatch
achievements.desc: Finish a daily challenge in government.
